name: JustBestow
author: ayatsolutions

sections.description:
JustBestow lets nonprofits and organizations accept donations directly on their WordPress website. Connect your Stripe account in a few clicks, drop the donation form onto any page, and start receiving donations — no coding required.

Everything else happens in your JustBestow Dashboard at client.justbestow.com: create and manage campaigns, see every donation as it comes in, and manage your donors and reports. The plugin stays light, so your site stays fast.

Why JustBestow?

  • Quick setup — install the plugin, connect Stripe, add the form. That’s it.
  • Simple, guided donation flow — donors choose an amount, enter their details, optionally dedicate their gift, and pay, in four short steps.
  • Secure payments by Stripe — card details go straight to Stripe and never touch your website or our servers.
  • Apple Pay and cards — donors can pay with a card or a digital wallet such as Apple Pay, where available.
  • Tribute donations — donors can give in honor of, in memory of, in celebration of, or in support of someone.
  • Works with your page builder — use the block editor, Elementor, or FluentForm.
  • Manage everything in one place — campaigns, donations and reports live in your JustBestow Dashboard.

How donors give

The donation form walks your donors through four simple steps:

  1. Choose an amount — pick a suggested amount ($10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500) or enter a custom amount.
  2. Tell us who is giving — first name, last name, phone and email.
  3. Dedicate the donation (optional) — in honor of, in memory of, in celebration of, or in support of someone.
  4. Donate — review the donation summary and pay securely with Apple Pay or a card.

Where you can add the donation form

  • Block editor (Gutenberg) — add the JustBestow block to any page or post.
  • Elementor — drag the JustBestow widget onto any Elementor page.
  • FluentForm — use JustBestow as a payment method in your FluentForm forms (requires FluentForm Pro with the Payments module enabled). You can also link a form to a specific campaign.

Your JustBestow Dashboard

Log in at client.justbestow.com to:

  • Create and manage your donation campaigns
  • View every donation in real time
  • Manage donations and donors
  • See reports on how your campaigns are doing

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to work.

JustBestow API

The plugin loads the donation form from the JustBestow API (api.justbestow.com) and uses it to connect your Stripe account, and to manage your campaigns, settings and donation data. Data is only sent when the plugin’s features are used, such as when the donation form is shown or a donation is made.

  • Terms of Service: https://ayatsolutions.com/just-bestow-terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://ayatsolutions.com/just-bestow-privacy-policy

Stripe

Donations are processed securely by Stripe. All card and payment information is handled directly by Stripe and is never stored on your website or on our servers.

  • Stripe Terms: https://stripe.com/legal
  • Stripe Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy
sections.installation:
Install from your WordPress dashboard (recommended)

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for JustBestow.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

You can also find the plugin at wordpress.org/plugins/just-bestow.

Install manually

  1. Download the plugin zip from wordpress.org/plugins/just-bestow.
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin, choose the zip file and click Install Now.
  3. Click Activate.

Or unzip it and upload the just-bestow folder to /wp-content/plugins/ over FTP, then activate it from the Plugins screen.

Get started

  1. Connect Stripe — open JustBestow in your WordPress admin menu and click Connect as Non-Profit. Follow the Stripe steps to connect your account, and you will be brought back to WordPress when you are done.
  2. Set up your dashboard — after connecting, check your email. We send you a link to set your password for the JustBestow Dashboard.
  3. Create a campaign — log in at client.justbestow.com and create the campaign you want to collect donations for.
  4. Add the form to your site — edit a page or post, add the JustBestow block (or the Elementor widget, or the FluentForm payment method), and publish. The donation form appears on your site, connected to your Stripe account.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Stripe account?

Yes. Donations are processed by Stripe. If you do not have an account yet, you can create one during the connection step.

Do I need a JustBestow account?

Your JustBestow Dashboard account is created for you when you connect Stripe. Check your email for the link to set your password, then log in at client.justbestow.com.

Where do I manage campaigns and donations?

In your JustBestow Dashboard at client.justbestow.com. There you can create campaigns, view and manage donations, and see reports. The WordPress plugin only connects your account and shows the donation form.

Is it secure?

Yes. All card and payment details are handled directly by Stripe. They are never stored on your website or on JustBestow servers.

Which payment methods can donors use?

Donors can pay by card, or with a digital wallet such as Apple Pay where their device and browser support it.

Can donors dedicate a donation to someone?

Yes. In the third step donors can choose to give in honor of, in memory of, in celebration of, or in support of someone, and enter the honoree’s name.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. When Elementor is active, a JustBestow widget is available in the Elementor editor.

Does it work with FluentForm?

Yes. With FluentForm Pro and its Payments module active, enable JustBestow under FluentForm’s payment settings and select it as the payment method in your form. You can optionally enter a Campaign ID so the form’s donations go to a specific campaign; leave it blank to use your default campaign.

How do I disconnect my Stripe account?

Open JustBestow in your WordPress admin menu and click Disconnect Stripe.

I connected Stripe but did not get an email. What should I do?

Check your spam folder first. If it is not there, contact us at info@ayatsolutions.com or through our contact page.
